#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reproduce the 2026-09-12 investigation from clean CMake builds."""
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import re
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = Path(os.environ['SWAN_AUDIT_REPOSITORY']).resolve()
CASE = REPO / 'examples/voordelta'
CPUS = [0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14]
OUTPUTS = ['voordelta_depth.blk', 'voordelta_hs.blk', 'voordelta_sites.tbl']
DATA = {
    'revision': os.environ['SWAN_AUDIT_REVISION'],
    'date_utc': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime()),
    'platform': platform.platform(),
    'cpu': next(l.split(':', 1)[1].strip() for l in Path('/proc/cpuinfo').read_text().splitlines() if l.startswith('model name')),
    'compiler': subprocess.check_output(['gfortran', '--version'], text=True).splitlines()[0],
    'cpus': CPUS,
    'builds': {},
    'runs': [],
    'batches': [],
}

def digest(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

for name in ['serial', 'openmp', 'lto', 'profile']:
    DATA['builds'][name] = {
        'sha256': digest(ROOT / name / 'bin/swan.exe'),
        'cache': {l.split('=', 1)[0]: l.split('=', 1)[1] for l in (ROOT / name / 'CMakeCache.txt').read_text().splitlines() if re.match(r'(CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS|CMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER:|OPENMP:|SWAN_LTO:|SWAN_NATIVE:|SWAN_DEBUG_INVARIANTS:|SWAN_RUNTIME_CHECKS:)', l)},
    }
DATA['inputs'] = {name: digest(CASE / name) for name in ['voordelta.swn', 'voordelta.dep']}

def save():
    (ROOT / 'measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(DATA, indent=2) + '\n')

def run(build, cpus, label, wait_policy='PASSIVE'):
    directory = ROOT / 'runs' / label
    directory.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copy2(CASE / 'voordelta.swn', directory / 'INPUT')
    shutil.copy2(CASE / 'voordelta.dep', directory / 'voordelta.dep')
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    environment.update(OMP_NUM_THREADS=str(len(cpus)), OMP_DYNAMIC='FALSE', OMP_PLACES='cores', OMP_PROC_BIND='close', OMP_WAIT_POLICY=wait_policy)
    cmd = ['taskset', '-c', ','.join(map(str, cpus)), str(ROOT / build / 'bin/swan.exe')]
    start = time.perf_counter()
    with (directory / 'screen.log').open('w') as stream:
        completed = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=directory, env=environment, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
    if completed.returncode or not (directory / 'norm_end').is_file():
        raise RuntimeError(f'{label} failed: {directory}')
    hashes = {name: digest(directory / name) for name in OUTPUTS}
    lines = (directory / 'voordelta_sites.tbl').read_text().splitlines()
    numerical = '\n'.join(' '.join(l.split()) for l in lines if l.strip() and not l.lstrip().startswith('%'))
    return {'label': label, 'build': build, 'cpus': cpus, 'wait_policy': wait_policy, 'seconds': elapsed,
            'sha256': hashes, 'table_data_sha256': hashlib.sha256(numerical.encode()).hexdigest(),
            'iterations': re.findall(r'iteration\s+(\d+)', (directory / 'screen.log').read_text(), re.I)}

REPO=Path(os.environ['SWAN_AUDIT_REPOSITORY']).resolve()
DEST=ROOT/'candidate3-src'

def main():
    shutil.copytree(ROOT/'candidate-src',DEST,dirs_exist_ok=True)
    # Start from the exact baseline; previous attribute experiments are excluded.
    for name in ['swan_source_workspaces.f90','swancom1.f90','swancom2.f90','swancom3.f90','swancom4.f90']:
        shutil.copy2(REPO/'src'/name,DEST/'src'/name)
    kernels={'swancom2.f90':['SBOT','SSURF','SWCAP'],'swancom3.f90':['SWIND0','SWIND3'],'swancom4.f90':['SWSNL2']}
    for filename,names in kernels.items():
        p=DEST/'src'/filename
        source=p.read_text()
        for name in names:
            pattern=re.compile(r'(?ims)^SUBROUTINE '+name+r'\s*\(.*?^end subroutine '+name+r'\b')
            match=pattern.search(source)
            assert match,name
            body=match.group(0)
            first,rest=body.split('\n',1)
            assert first.rstrip().endswith(')'),first
            first=first.rstrip()[:-1]+', RECORD_BUDGET)'
            body=first+'\n'+rest
            trace=re.search(r'(?m)^\s*(?:ASSOCIATE\(|IF \(LTRACE\) CALL STRACE)[^\n]*',body)
            assert trace,name
            insertion='\n   LOGICAL, OPTIONAL, INTENT(IN) :: RECORD_BUDGET\n   LOGICAL :: DO_BUDGET\n\n   DO_BUDGET = .TRUE.\n   IF (PRESENT(RECORD_BUDGET)) DO_BUDGET = RECORD_BUDGET\n'
            body=body[:trace.start()]+insertion+body[trace.start():]
            lines=body.splitlines(keepends=True);out=[];i=0;count=0
            while i<len(lines):
                line=lines[i]
                if re.match(r'\s*(?:DISSC[01]|GENC[01]|REDC[01])\s*\([^)]*\)\s*=',line):
                    indent=line[:len(line)-len(line.lstrip())]
                    out.append(indent+'IF (DO_BUDGET) THEN\n')
                    while True:
                        out.append(lines[i])
                        continued=lines[i].rstrip().endswith('&')
                        i+=1
                        if not continued:break
                    out.append(indent+'END IF\n');count+=1
                else:
                    out.append(line);i+=1
            assert count>0,name
            print(name,'guarded writes',count,flush=True)
            source=source[:match.start()]+''.join(out)+source[match.end():]
        p.write_text(source)
    p=DEST/'src/swancom1.f90';source=p.read_text()
    start=source.index('               SUBROUTINE SOURCE (')
    end=source.index('               end subroutine SOURCE',start)
    body=source[start:end]
    body=body.replace('                  TYPE(source_budget_t) :: SOURCE_BUDGET','                  TYPE(source_budget_t) :: SOURCE_BUDGET\n                  LOGICAL :: RECORD_SOURCE_BUDGET',1)
    first=body.index('                  SOURCE_BUDGET%dissc0(1:MDC')
    last=body.index('                  SOURCE_BUDGET%redc1(1:MDC',first)
    last=body.index('\n',last)+1
    policy='''                  ! Bounded experiment: preserve all other physics routes.

'''
